description: Scan the open project for structural problems and return a read-only report: binder entries with missing, malformed, or duplicate UUIDs, entries missing their type, and text documents whose backing content is unreadable or empty. Use when a project looks corrupted, after manual edits to the .scrivx file, or before a bulk operation; not when you just want the document tree (use get_structure) or a single document (use get_document_info). This tool only detects problems and never repairs them. related: get_structure, get_document_info. Requires an open project.

includeTrash.description: Whether to also verify documents in the project trash. Defaults to true so the whole project is checked; set false to skip trashed items.

name: verify_project_integrity

issues.description: Every integrity problem found; empty when the project is clean.

id.description: Scrivener UUID of the offending item, when known.

ok.description: True when no error-severity issues were found.

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the check.

title: Verify Project Integrity
